messages:
olivia: hey docs — quick heads up. I'm hitting a 404 when following step 3 in the runtime onboarding runbook: https://redwood.dev/runbooks/runtime/onboarding (production). Also the curl sample still shows `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` but we moved to `X-API-Key` header last week. Can someone own a tiny fix?
sam: oof. thanks for flagging. cc @devin and @marcus :wave:
devin: i can take this. do you want me to just update the url & header in-place? any tests to run?
olivia: yes please — update the link to /runbooks/runtime/onboarding/v2 (that was the new slug). No tests required, just preview and confirm the live link.
marcus: if the slug change is from yesterday's routing deploy, infra should add a redirect. i'll open an infra ticket after you push. for now a doc patch is fine.
devin: working on it. small PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/842 — updates path + curl snippet. preview looks good. PTAL.
sam: pinging reviewers. quick check: add a one-liner in the commit message referencing the routing change.
deploy-bot: docs-preview build #7843 succeeded — https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/7843 :white_check_mark:
devin: cool, merge incoming once CI green.
olivia: merged and confirmed the new link resolves. curl sample now shows `-H 'X-API-Key: $REDWOOD_KEY'`. thanks everyone :tada:
marcus: infra ticket created #INF-1123 to add permanent redirect.
